def ledger(ops: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[int]]:
    balances = {}
    frozen = set()
    history = []
    rejected = []

    def amount(token):
        if not token or any(c < "0" or c > "9" for c in token):
            return None
        # Convert in small chunks to support arbitrarily long digit strings.
        value = 0
        for i in range(0, len(token), 9):
            chunk = token[i:i + 9]
            value = value * (10 ** len(chunk)) + int(chunk)
        return value

    for index, operation in enumerate(ops):
        parts = operation.split(" ")
        verb = parts[0]
        success = False

        if verb == "open" and len(parts) == 3:
            account, token = parts[1], parts[2]
            n = amount(token)
            if n is not None and account and account not in balances:
                balances[account] = n
                history.append(("open", account))
                success = True

        elif verb == "deposit" and len(parts) == 3:
            account, token = parts[1], parts[2]
            n = amount(token)
            if n is not None and n > 0 and account in balances:
                balances[account] += n
                history.append(("deposit", account, n))
                success = True

        elif verb == "withdraw" and len(parts) == 3:
            account, token = parts[1], parts[2]
            n = amount(token)
            if (n is not None and n > 0 and account in balances
                    and account not in frozen and balances[account] >= n):
                balances[account] -= n
                history.append(("withdraw", account, n))
                success = True

        elif verb == "transfer" and len(parts) == 4:
            source, target, token = parts[1], parts[2], parts[3]
            n = amount(token)
            if (n is not None and n > 0 and source != target
                    and source in balances and target in balances
                    and source not in frozen and balances[source] >= n):
                balances[source] -= n
                balances[target] += n
                history.append(("transfer", source, target, n))
                success = True

        elif verb == "freeze" and len(parts) == 2:
            account = parts[1]
            if account in balances and account not in frozen:
                frozen.add(account)
                history.append(("freeze", account))
                success = True

        elif verb == "unfreeze" and len(parts) == 2:
            account = parts[1]
            if account in balances and account in frozen:
                frozen.remove(account)
                history.append(("unfreeze", account))
                success = True

        elif verb == "undo" and len(parts) == 1 and history:
            entry = history.pop()
            kind = entry[0]
            if kind == "open":
                del balances[entry[1]]
            elif kind == "deposit":
                balances[entry[1]] -= entry[2]
            elif kind == "withdraw":
                balances[entry[1]] += entry[2]
            elif kind == "transfer":
                balances[entry[1]] += entry[3]
                balances[entry[2]] -= entry[3]
            elif kind == "freeze":
                frozen.remove(entry[1])
            else:
                frozen.add(entry[1])
            success = True

        if not success:
            rejected.append(index)

    return balances, rejected
